meaning: Six field countdowns run TrickRoom, Gravity, WaterSportField, MudSportField, WonderRoom, MagicRoom; positive values only decrement; reaching zero requests the corresponding message. Fields initialize zero; default move producer classes establish five, rooms toggle an existing positive value to zero, Gravity/sports reject an existing positive value.

MagicRoom natural zero requests its message then obtains pbPriority(true) and checks each returned battler terrain item. pbPriority(true) builds a new speed-only result from existing cached speed/tie-break data and includes cached fainted objects; it performs no speed recomputation. EOR entry separately invokes priority calculation and stores its own earlier array.

No universal refresh is attached to every field expiry. Later itemActive reads MagicRoom, airborne reads Gravity, defensive accessors read WonderRoom. Direct MagicRoom cancellation has no seed-check loop in that producer.
normal_and_boundary: All timers 1: decrement/messages in six-field order. Timers 0/-1: no local decrement or expiry message. MagicRoom1 with live Electric Seed holder on Electric terrain and Defense0: zero then seed checker; max-stage holder leaves seed intact.
A speed change with no intervening priority calculation does not change cached speed data merely by this fresh query; EOR earlier array is not retroactively resorted.
facts.error_prefix: Countdown write precedes message. A message error leaves zero and skips its later seed loop/remaining field calls. A seed stat change precedes its consumption; a failure after the stat write can leave the changed stage and unconsumed item. No enclosing transaction/ensure in these methods.
facts.persistence_reload: Timers/priority/stages are battle runtime. Seed item removal writes through to Pokemon and can update battle restoration/recycle/Pickup ledgers. Serialization/reload is outside this four-locator static contribution.
facts.reuse_scope: Only exact cache/field/seed callback facts; neither additional full locator is reviewed here.

meaning: The entire default TerrainStatBoost family is four seeds: Electric/Grassy require matching terrain and a permitted Defense raise; Misty/Psychic require matching terrain and a permitted Special Defense raise. They request UseItem then nominal +1 by cause; only truthy successful change reaches held-item-triggered consumption.

There is no affectedByTerrain/grounded gate in these four seed handlers. itemActive requires living holder, no positive Embargo/MagicRoom, no corrosive-gas party flag, and no active Klutz. Stage permission and actual change honor the read Contrary/Simple/current ability logic and +/-6 clamp.

Consumption records recoverable item in recycle and PickupItem with a monotonically incremented PickupUse, updates belch only for a berry, clears matching initial restore identity on permanent remove, writes current held item nil through to Pokemon, then checks Symbiosis. Symbiosis takes first qualifying same-side active bearer in its current cached-speed query, transfers eligible item, and invokes held checks; this is conditional, not a universal new item.
normal_and_boundary: Flying live Electric Seed holder on Electric terrain, no item blockers, Defense0: nominal Defense+1 and consumption despite airborne state. Terrain mismatch or blocked item or capped permitted stage: no consumption.
First seed consumption can obtain a second eligible seed via Symbiosis; a later outer repeated item check can therefore have a real effect. Otherwise consumed seed is absent and does not raise twice.
facts.error_prefix: Stage write/message precede handler true and outer consume. Failure before return true leaves earlier stage effect without consumption. During consume, recycle/Pickup/belch/restore/current-item writes occur in stated order; a later Symbiosis/display failure does not roll them back.
facts.persistence_reload: Stage changes and ledgers are battle state; current held item writes persistent Pokemon. Normal terminal restoration reads the updated restoration array; no saved-file round-trip guarantee.
facts.reuse_scope: Four seed handlers, exact wrapper/consumption gates and reached prefix only; no whole Item/Ability domain approval.

meaning: Positive terrain duration decrements. Expiry needs current terrain non-None AND duration zero; requests old-terrain end message, writes None, then queries current living allBattlers for terrain ability callbacks.

With non-None default it calls pbStartTerrain(nil,default,false): writes default and duration -1, animation/message requests, all living ability callbacks then all living seed checks. The outer expiry then performs another all-living ability pass and another all-living item pass. Total ability notifications: clear-to-None once, restored default twice; seed checks twice. These are distinct current live collections, not the original EOR cached array.

Default OnTerrainChange family contains only Mimicry. AbilityActive is checked at callback entry. None resets runtime typing from current Pokemon types and clears extra/burn-up/roost flags; Electric/Grassy/Misty/Psychic resolve to ELECTRIC/GRASS/FAIRY/PSYCHIC if registered, then change runtime typing. It has no already-the-same-type no-op guard, so repeated restored callbacks can repeat messages/state assignment.

Continuation uses restored current terrain and its registered animation/message. If None remains, only terrain helper returns. Earlier Grassy healing was before this expiry. Steel Roller and Gen8 Defog direct removal leave duration and do not invoke natural-expiry notifications/default restart; later None+zero does not satisfy expiry.
normal_and_boundary: Grassy1/defaultElectric: earlier eligible healing then Grassy end; Mimicry base reset, Electric start+Mimicry, seed pass, Mimicry again+seed pass, Electric continuation.
Non-None terrain duration -1 continues without decrement/expiry. None duration1 becomes0 with no default restart. Natural expiry without default clears and returns helper; overall EOR continues.
facts.error_prefix: Duration decrement precedes old-terrain message, so message failure may leave old terrain with zero duration. None write precedes ability pass; a failure there leaves None and does not reach default restart. Restart current terrain/duration writes precede start animation/messages; later failures preserve restored state and completed callbacks; no rollback or guaranteed remaining outer pass.
facts.persistence_reload: Terrain and Mimicry typing are battle runtime; seed effects may write persistent held items. No terrain serializer/reload invoked in these methods.
facts.reuse_scope: Natural-expiry ordering, concrete Mimicry/seeds and direct-removal contrast only; no complete extra locator review.

meaning: Per cached member self-effect helper skips fainted first; for actual hyper mode draws 0..99, <10 writes Pokemon.hyper_mode false then calm message, else hyper message. Then positive Uproar decrements/message; then positive SlowStart decrements and zero-only message.

Current Battler.inHyperMode override skips fainted and reads Pokemon.hyper_mode, whose getter is false at heart gauge0 or HP0. Entry definition needs living shadow/player/not already hyper and its heart-dependent draw; the actual move path calls it at the read reached post-action guard choice !=None. This is a conditional producer trace, not full move/lifecycle acceptance.

Uproar default producer establishes3 and current move only when not already positive and cures currently sleeping non-Soundproof cached members. SlowStart switch-in registration establishes5; initialization is0; losing the ability clears its timer.
normal_and_boundary: Hyper draw9 calms,10 remains; no hyper draw when not hyper. Uproar1→0 calm;2→1 continued message. SlowStart1→0 end message;2→1 silent. Fainted member does none of these local writes.
facts.error_prefix: Hyper write precedes calm display; Uproar decrement precedes its display; SlowStart decrement precedes zero display. Failure preserves earlier writes and aborts remaining local/caller operations, with no local rollback.
facts.persistence_reload: Hyper flag writes persistent Pokemon. Uproar/SlowStart are battle effects. No save/load executed; full purification/world shadow lifecycle is outside this finite EOR receiver.

meaning: Immediately after each member self-helper, caller separately reads abilityActive before EndOfRoundEffect, itemActive before item EndOfRoundEffect, and abilityActive again before EndOfRoundGainItem. No common eligibility snapshot or intervening universal decision stop is present.

Default late ability effects are Bad Dreams, Moody, Speed Boost. Bad Dreams scans current living opposite-side battlers, requires nearby and asleep (including Komala/Comatose status predicate), checks indirect-damage eligibility, then totalHP/8 effect damage with HP-item→halfHP ability→faint pipeline.

Moody generation8 uses five main battle stats, excluding accuracy/evasion; older branch includes those. Build currently permitted up/down sets; if both empty no effect. Sample an up stat if possible, nominal+2, remove that identity from down set; sample remaining down if possible, nominal-1. Then White Herb check iff down list remained nonempty, and always statsDropped item check. Self-inflicted stat loss does not trigger default Competitive/Defiant, whose same-side user guard skips.

Speed Boost requires turnCount>0, choice not Run and current speed raise permission, then nominal+1 ability raise. Current phase increments live turnCount at attack entry; initialization0 means later replacement normally skips first end round.
normal_and_boundary: Moody all five stats+6: up set empty but down set possible; down occurs. Up-selected stat is excluded from down selection even if it was originally in both. At generation8 Accuracy/Evasion alone uncapped does not populate sets.
SpeedBoost turnCount0 or choiceRun: no boost; turnCount1/noRun/stage0: +1. BadDreams ordinary nearby sleep is hurt; distant, awake, fainted, or MagicGuard target avoids damage.
facts.error_prefix: Moody up write can survive later down/WhiteHerb/EjectPack failure. BadDreams HP write can survive message/heal/callback failure. Each caller recheck reads reached state; a retired/fainted current member fails subsequent ordinary active gates. No local atomic acquire-and-trigger or full rollback.
facts.persistence_reload: Stages/runtime markers belong to battle. HP and obtained/consumed items write through to Pokemon; their exact ledger updates are in ERT-ITEM-PIPE and ERT-GAINITEM. C0122 downstream faint lifecycle is not re-adjudicated here.
facts.reuse_scope: Exact effect-damage pipeline and finite item/halfHP reached gates, not all damage-producing moves.

meaning: FlameOrb calls current self burn-permission then Burn with nil source; ToxicOrb self poison-permission then bad Poison with nil source. Gates include living/status, self-inflicted substitute bypass, terrain/Misty immunity, actual type and ability immunities; self source can supply Corrosion for poison. Safeguard condition requires non-self move and does not block these item paths.

Infliction writes current and Pokemon status/count, clears Toxic accumulator, requests animation/message, checks form, OnStatusInflicted then item/ability cures. Toxic uses statusCount1 and accumulator0. Nil infliction source makes default Synchronize handler skip. StickyBarb requires indirect-damage eligibility then nominal totalHP/8 via effect pipeline.
These handlers run after ordinary poison/burn residual stage; newly inflicted status does not go back and re-run that passed stage.
normal_and_boundary: StatusNONE unprotected grounded normal type FlameOrb: burn, no same-round earlier burn residual. Existing status or FIRE type prevents burn. Misty affected holder prevents both. Toxic ordinary eligible holder gets bad poison count1; MagicGuard blocks StickyBarb indirect damage.
facts.error_prefix: Status setter may write battle/Pokemon status and refresh before count and animation; subsequent failure preserves prefix. StickyBarb damage/HP-item/faint prefixes as ERT-ITEM-PIPE. No local cancellation prompt or rollback.
facts.persistence_reload: Status/count and HP write persistent Pokemon. Toxic accumulator is battle runtime. Ordinary terminal/world status normalization and full reload are separate contracts.

meaning: BallFetch requires currently empty item and nonnil first failed ball; assigns current item through Pokemon, fills initial restoration only if missing, clears first-ball record, messages then held checks. Producer pbThrowPokeBall writes first ball only on reached noncapture outcome and only before failure latch is set; no-target/trainer-block early returns do not reach this write. Fetch does not reset failure latch.

Harvest requires empty item and a recycle record whose actual item Berry flag is true. Effective Sun/HarshSun skips random test; otherwise draw<50. Effective weather reads CloudNine/AirLock and active UtilityUmbrella suppression. Assign current item, clear recycle, fill missing initial restore, message then held checks. Immediate berry consumption can create a new recycle/Pickup record again.

Pickup requires empty item. From current living allBattlers other than self choose strictly greatest positive PickupUse; ties keep first in battler-array scan. Transfer PickupItem into holder; clear donor PickupItem/PickupUse; clear donor recycle if identity equals found item. In wild battle only, if recipient initial missing and donor initial equals found, transfer restore identity too. Then message and held checks. Donor record is produced by recoverable pbConsumeItem and monotonic nextPickupUse.

Acquisition has no common initial eligibility snapshot with earlier ability/item effects. Held checks are current-state checks. Reconsuming a picked-up berry creates a newer pickup record that later members can see.
normal_and_boundary: BallFetch empty item/firstballPOKEBALL returns ball and clears firstball; already-held or nil firstball local skip.

Harvest berry recycle in effectiveSun restores with no new draw; nonsun draw49 restores,50 skips; nonberry skips. Pickup live use8 beatsuse3; faint donor excluded, use0 excluded, tie8 keeps first; wild identity transfer only under all three restoration conditions.
facts.error_prefix: BallFetch assigns before clearing firstball; display failure after clear leaves item/ledger and no firstball. Harvest assigns before clearing recycle/filling restore; held-check failure after these writes does not undo them. Pickup assigns before donor field clearing, then optional ledger transfer; a later display/trigger failure leaves transfer prefix. No all-or-nothing guarantee.
facts.persistence_reload: Current item writes persistent Pokemon. Initial/recycle/Pickup and first-ball records are battle runtime; normal terminal reads current initial record. No Bag transaction or save/load is invoked by these callbacks.

meaning: pbTakeEffectDamage clears halfHP marker, rounds/clamps/reduces HP (minimum1 when living), yields damage message, invokes current HP-item check, then halfHP ability, then conditional Faint, then clears marker. Healing to >=half clears the marker before halfHP callback. A fainted item holder fails ordinary itemActive; items do not revive here.

Ordinary held trigger checks living/currentitemActive once at entry, then HPHeal, StatusCure, EndOfMove checks; each helper rechecks living/itemActive as coded and chooses its current item. HPHeal true invokes held-triggered consumption; false ordinary route then tries terrain seeds. CheekPouch heals totalHP/3 for a triggered berry when active and canHeal before consumption. Consume may call Symbiosis and nested held checks. Forced item_to_use/positive-hit berry path is read but excluded from ordinary EOR because caller passes none.

HPHeal complete default family has sixteen registrations; detailed manual meanings in item_family_meanings. Success generally changes HP/stage/flag before outer consumption. StatusCure complete default family has eight; Leppa and WhiteHerb each one.

WhiteHerb sets every negative battle stage0 and statsRaisedThisRound true, preserving statsDropped; if none negative returnsfalse. EjectPack requires statsDropped and currentitemActive at wrapper; handler rejects SkyDrop, all foes unavailable, wild bearer, trapped/unavailable switch or no legal nonactive. It requests use/message, consumes with Symbiosis disabled, then EOR branch recalls and invokes leaving ability handling; this marks the battler hp0/fainted locally and defers replacement to later pbEORSwitch. NonEOR replacement-selection route is not applied to this fact.

HalfHP EmergencyExit/WimpOut: wild branch requires actual escape permission (and opposing wild has no multiple living same-side restriction); writes decision3 after reached audio/message. Trainer branch checks foes/switch/nonactive then EOR recalls/leaves with no immediate replacement. Remaining full escape policy and existing C0122 faint/presentation closures stay with root actual readers.
normal_and_boundary: Effect damage that crosses half then Sitrus heals back to>=half: subsequent halfHP marker is false. AtHP0 ordinary itemActivefalse, then Faint reached after other helper returns.

Moody+WhiteHerb restores negatives and consumes; statsDropped remains true. EjectPack already held and legal trainer reserve: consumed before EOR retirement, actual replacement later. A failed switching gate leaves pack unconsumed.

Plain nonforced Leppa restores first zero-PP move among current persistent moves, capped totalPP and mirrors battle movePP; merely partialPP with no zeroPP does not trigger. WhiteHerb no negative stat no consume.
facts.error_prefix: HP is written before scene wait and damage message. Callback failure before HP-item check leaves lostHP; HP-item effect can precede its own consumption; consume ledger writes precede Symbiosis. WhiteHerb resets may precede animation/display and later consume failure. EjectPack consumes before recall/leaving handling, so a recall/callback failure can leave it consumed without completed retirement/replacement. pbFaint effects occur only if reached. No local ensure/transaction; outer diagnostic may return after reporting ordinary failure and does not repair prefix.
facts.persistence_reload: HP/status/item/PP writes persistent Pokemon; stages and per-battle ledgers runtime. Full storage identity, serializer/reload, actual scene animation and input completion are excluded from static fact, not silently passed.
facts.reuse_scope: Exact HP-item→halfHP→Faint pipeline plus read default item families/current gates. Root can join its already-read C0122/Scene/Pokedex contracts without creating new source or global gate.

meaning: After growth returns and decision remains nonpositive, cached members are passed pbCheckForm(true), before EORSwitch. Helper rejects fainted/Transform; it does not run pbCheckFormOnWeatherChange on this endOfRound entry. Complete concrete family here is five species; detailed conditions in form_family_meanings.

Darmanitan/ZenMode, Minior/ShieldsDown, Wishiwashi/Schooling and Zygarde/PowerConstruct compare current raw ability identity; Morpeko/HungerSwitch queries active ability. These gates must not be homogenized to all use abilityActive.

pbChangeForm itself rejects fainted/Transform/same form. It saves old absolute damage, writes Battler.form and Pokemon.form; Pokemon setter resets ability cache, optional onSetForm dispatch, stat recompute, player Pokedex registration. Selected five species registrations contain no onSetForm hook. pbUpdate(true) recomputes/reads level HP totalHP stats and (when not transformed) types/ability; direct battler HP becomes new totalHP minus saved damage; generation>=6 clears weight change. Then changePokemon/refresh/message/seen requests. It does not refresh moves or run ability-losing/gaining callbacks merely because loop called it.

Five base plus fifteen explicit form records are fully read. Missing Minior meteor1–6 raw form records resolve through get_species_form base fallback; defined forms inherit unspecified base properties through full read form compiler validator. Default raw record and ability index determine postchange ability. These are finite source/data facts, not target rendering proof.

Later Peer leaving handler reads species form callback and may revert Darmanitan to even base family; Wishiwashi0; Minior to core if meteor; Zygarde subtract2 if fainted/endBattle; Morpeko0 if fainted/endBattle. This uses persistent form setter; normal terminal restores held item from current initial array after leaving callback.
normal_and_boundary: Darmanitan0/ZenMode HP<=floorhalf→1,2→3; odd withHP>half→previous even. Minior meteor0..6 at<=half→+7; core>=7 at>half→-7.

Wishiwashi level>=20 andHP>floorquarter→1, else0. Zygarde rawPowerConstruct/endRound/HP<=half/form0or1→+2. Morpeko activeHungerSwitch/endRound toggles0/1 with no extra splash/message. Fainted/Transform skips all; same desired form skips mutation.
facts.error_prefix: Persistent form and ability-cache reset precede stat recompute/Pokedex; later failure can leave changed form with incompletely refreshed battler. Later scene/message failure preserves completed persistent/stat changes. The loop supplies no rollback or guarantee of reaching EORSwitch/normal terminal. Cancellation is absent inside these automatic branches.
facts.persistence_reload: Persistent form/stats/HP/ability cache/Pokedex can change; runtime types/stats copy follows actual updater. Later leaving callback may revert temporary battle form. No serializer/reload is invoked or executed; this does not promise battle form survives after leaving.
facts.reuse_scope: Five actual pbCheckForm(true) species and their finite setter/raw/leaving chain only, not entire creature transformation domain.

meaning: At reached ordinary EOR methods no transaction or ensure undoes earlier writes. Caller loop wraps EOR with PBDebug.logonerr: ordinary rescued exception is logged/reported/flushed; if diagnostic itself completes, phase call can return to the decision check and next loop. It does not resume skipped later statements inside the aborted EOR call.
The exact runtime cannot be inferred from exception text alone: reporting/scene may themselves fail, special abort is separate, and already committed data is not repaired by this wrapper.
normal_and_boundary: Normal complete EOR clears endOfRound false at its final line. Early decision exits or error before final line can leave it true. No extra decision stop exists between each late handler.
facts.error_prefix: A field/item/form/display failure leaves its stated prefix. Outer report success does not establish business rollback or that EOR tail ran. Special abort/full host error behavior is not retested.
facts.persistence_reload: No save/reload call appears in the finite callbacks; working object writes remain until an actually reached later consumer changes them.
